# Supports and tanks where every fight is won (generated by measures/support_stages.py)

Balance variant, 60 battles a cell. Each role in the last place of the reference party. Cells: the lowest share of HP the party fell to during the fight / the share it ended with / the length of the fight. The last columns are the mean over the checkpoints of the difference from the median role of the table: points of lowest HP (more is safer) and length (less is faster).
